seo.title: ReportAI — Inspection reports, dictated by voice
seo.description: Dictate the visit on Telegram when you finish and get the report in your own Word template, with the issues, who fixes them and by when. For safety, inspection and maintenance teams. On your own server.

cta.mailSubject: I want to try ReportAI with my template

hero.eyebrow: For safety, inspection and maintenance teams
hero.subheadline: When the visit's done, you send a voice note on Telegram. ReportAI fills in your Word template with it: what you saw, the issues, who fixes them and by when. Once you approve it, it goes to the right people.
hero.note: Installed on your own server: the recordings and reports stay with you.

realDemo.heading: This isn't a mockup.
realDemo.paragraph: A site inspection, dictated and run through the real system: transcription, extraction and the filled-in template. Nothing was touched up afterwards, not even the transcript's typos. Press play.

realDemo.note: The voice is synthetic, and the site, companies and people are fictional. Everything else is the system's real output, which cost under 3 cents of AI.

howItWorks.heading: From voice note to delivered report.
howItWorks.sub: Five steps. You do two: dictate and approve.

record.title: You dictate the inspection
record.body: Leaving the site, in the car or the site office. On Telegram, like any voice note, with photos if you like.

transcribe.title: It's transcribed
transcribe.body: In seconds, in English or Spanish, with the speech service you choose.

extract.title: The fields are filled in
extract.body: Site, contractors, issues with who fixes them and by when: your template's sections. If something required is missing, it asks.

approve.title: You approve it
approve.body: Review the draft in the chat and confirm, or correct it with a voice or text reply.

deliver.title: It's delivered
deliver.body: Your template as a PDF, emailed to the contractor, the client or whoever you set up, and kept in the history.

useCases.heading: Built for people on site, not in the office.
useCases.sub: Start with the site safety inspection. Any document with fixed sections can be dictated the same way.

safetyVisit.title: Site safety inspections
safetyVisit.body: Contractors on site, issues with the contractor responsible, corrective action and deadline, work stopped and site log entries. Comes as a starter template.

incident.title: Incidents and accidents
incident.body: What happened, where, how serious and what has been done already. Dictated on the spot, reviewed calmly. Also a starter template.

custom.title: Whatever you fill in by hand today
custom.body: Coordination meeting minutes, checklists, work orders. Upload your Word file and the assistant proposes the fields.

differentiator.heading: No more writing reports at night.
differentiator.paragraph: Today an inspection means notes in a notebook and photos on your phone, typed up into Word at the end of the day. With ReportAI it's done before you're back at the car.

templateFidelity.heading: Your template, not ours.
templateFidelity.paragraph: Upload the Word file you already use, with your logo and layout. The assistant reads it and proposes its fields and where each one goes; you correct it, preview it as a PDF with sample data and switch it on. No generic PDF with your logo slapped on top.
templateFidelity.check: No template yet? Start with the site safety inspection one, already with your logo, and adjust it in Word.

approval.heading: It asks for what's missing. Nothing goes out unapproved.
approval.paragraph1: Every report reaches the chat first as a draft. If something required is missing, like a deadline, the bot asks you. If something is off, you correct it with a reply and it's generated again.
approval.paragraph2: It runs on Telegram: your team installs it once and talks to your company's bot like any other contact. Approvers can also review, correct and approve from the panel.

install.q: Do I need to know about servers?
install.a: No. If we install it, we leave it running on a server of yours or a VPS in your name. If someone at your company is technical, it installs with a single command following the guide.

channels.q: Does my team have to install anything?
channels.a: Telegram, once. You send each person an invite link from the panel; opening it is all they need to start dictating. WhatsApp is in testing.

errors.q: What if it gets something wrong?
errors.a: The draft reaches the chat before it's sent, and nothing goes out without your approval. If something required is missing, the bot asks; if something's wrong, you correct it with a reply. Every field is validated: a date has to be a date.

data.a: On your server: recordings, photos, reports and templates. To transcribe and fill in, the text goes through the AI provider you choose, with your own keys, and the messages through Telegram. Keys are stored encrypted.

ai.a: An AI model drafts it from what you dictate and doesn't fill in what you didn't say: it asks for what's missing. The content remains the responsibility of whoever approves it.

languages.q: Which languages does it work in?
languages.a: English and Spanish. The example on this page exists in both.

documents.q: Does it work for other documents?
documents.a: Yes. It comes with starter templates for site safety inspections, work orders, site visit reports and incident reports, and you can upload any Word file with fixed sections.

price.a: Installing it yourself is free. If we install and maintain it, it's a one-off fee plus a monthly fee, fixed once we've seen your template. Separately, you pay for your server (about €9 a month) and the AI (cents per report).
